He was often seen prostrating in prayer even when performing menial tasks. He was given the title 'As-Sharaf' meaning 'The Noble One' by the Prophet himself in recognition of his noble character.

historical_references.reference: Sharaf al-Din ibn Arsalan, a Persian scholar and poet, was a significant figure in the early Islamic Golden Age. The name 'Sharaf al-Din' means 'Noble Faith' and was given in recognition of his deep religious commitment.
